licensePolicy.error.category: Unknown category. Use permissive, weak_copyleft, copyleft, proprietary, public_domain or unknown.
licensePolicy.error.empty: Enter a license id or a category.
licensePolicy.error.match: Use one SPDX license id (optionally WITH an exception) or category:<name>.
licensePolicy.noRules: No rules: every known license gets the default verdict.
licensePolicy.pageDescription: Allow, review or deny the licenses your open-source packages declare. Denied licenses open findings.
licensePolicy.reviewFindingsHelp: Medium findings; otherwise review verdicts only show in the inventory.
licensePolicy.saveFailed: The license policy could not be saved.
licensePolicy.saved: Saved: {violations} packages flagged, {created} findings opened, {resolved} resolved.
licensePolicy.savedNotEvaluated: Saved. Evaluating the inventory did not finish; it runs again on the next package write.
licensePolicy.section.generalHelp: Judges the licenses each package declares. A denied license opens a high finding per asset and package.
licensePolicy.section.rulesHelp: An SPDX id (MIT, GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0) or a category (category:copyleft). A rule for an id beats a category rule; for the same match the first rule that applies to the dependency scope wins. In MIT OR GPL-3.0-only the most permissive allowed choice counts.
